David Smotrich & Partners Architects is a committed, passionate group of design professionals with depth and diversity of experience that allows us to address a wide variety of project types successfully. We draw upon our collective expertise to provide full-service architectural design with a niche in Higher Educational and Public Sector projects. We are proud of our dynamic, stable, and energetic working environment. Your contribution will shape the outcome of projects, and you will be recognized for the contributions you make.
We are a medium-sized, award-winning architectural practice and we are seeking self-motivated Intermediate Architectural Designers to join our team.
Position Description: We are seeking highly motivated Intermediate Architectural Designers with 5+ years of experience. The ideal candidates will have experience in all phases of design, from surveying, to preparing schematic designs and have the capability to generate detailed CD’s, as well as actively run Construction Administration for a project. The successful candidate will join our close-knit studio with the opportunity to become a valued team member and with the potential to manage and mentor Junior Architects.
Capabilities:
In addition to our competitive wages, we offer a substantial compensation package along with the opportunity to become an integral part of the continued growth of our organization. This position is in office.
Base Salary will be determined based on a variety of factors including the experience and expertise of individual Candidates. It is anticipated that the Base Salary range will be between $60,000.00 - $85,000.00. Base Salary is part of the overall compensation package. In addition to the Base Salary many additional benefits are also offered. The full compensation package will be reviewed in detail with select Candidates.
Non-national applicants must have a valid, and current, U.S. work authorization ID/Permit.
If this sounds like an exciting position to you, please forward your cover letter, resume, and portfolio to [email protected].
